assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent production animation sprite atlas for Bodega do Sadi, a warm rural southern Brazilian top-down 3/4 RPG. Create a NEW character: Monge João Maria, inspired by historical photographs of João Maria de Jesus, the wandering monk of the Contestado. Match the visual language of the game's David Canabarro sheet seen in context: polished hand-painted pixel art, crisp dark brown outlines, readable pixel clusters, warm restrained earthy colors, compact adult proportions with head about one-quarter of body height. Subject: an elderly slender pilgrim with a weathered warm light complexion, narrow kind face, prominent nose, deep-set eyes, bushy gray-white eyebrows, long full gray-white beard extending to mid-chest and wavy gray hair reaching the neck. Wear a SMALL rounded dark brown fur cap/barrete WITHOUT a wide brim, coarse beige linen shirt, worn open taupe-brown jacket ending at the hips, loose dark umber trousers ending at ankles, humble leather sandals with visible feet, and a discreet wooden rosary/cross at the chest. Carries one simple tall irregular wooden walking staff in his RIGHT hand in EVERY pose. No wizard fantasy costume, long robe, pointed hat, glow, halo, weapons or military ornaments. Keep both legs clearly readable and able to walk beneath the short jacket. Exactly TWELVE isolated full-body poses in FOUR columns and THREE rows on a genuinely transparent alpha background. Same character, identical clothing and body scale, consistent camera slightly above, broad empty gutters and no cropped staffs or feet. Each figure centered in its cell, no overlapping cells or grounded shadows. Row 1 facing FRONT: 0 relaxed standing with staff planted; 1 walking left-foot forward and staff forward; 2 walking right-foot forward, staff slightly behind; 3 passing gait with one bent knee lifted. Row 2 facing RIGHT: 4 standing full profile; 5 clearly left-leg forward stride; 6 opposite right-leg forward stride; 7 passing bent-knee stride. Staff arm follows a believable gentle walking rhythm. Left free arm swings opposite advancing leg. Row 3: 8 BACK standing; 9 BACK left-foot step; 10 BACK right-foot step; 11 FRONT three-quarter view with the left hand raised in a calm blessing/conversation gesture, right hand resting on staff. All figures remain upright, no huge stride or sprint, dignified slow pilgrimage walk. Ensure feet alternate visibly instead of duplicating poses. Entire hats, staffs, hands and soles visible within each cell, generous transparent padding. No lettering, captions, borders, labels, watermark, background scenery or extra props. Render with the same painterly pixel-art finish and useful game sprite proportions as the existing characters, not photorealistic and not 3D.
